summary: Quiet cul-de-sac bend kerb where cars park; houses 10-25 m away.

drivers.seclusion: Houses 20 m and 24 m away on this side; carport 14 m; more homes across the road.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed residential street with cars already parked on the kerb; room to stop.
drivers.traffic: Quiet cul-de-sac type street, little through traffic.
drivers.convention: Several cars parked on this kerb in the imagery; no signs mapped.

flags: Steep: street grades up to 14% locally, about 4.5% at the section
sun_shade: Mostly open; tree canopy on the south side shades part of it from the afternoon.
cannot_judge: Whether residents object to long stays

best_section.where: Birdvale Street bend, south kerb, just before the uphill rise
